{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles
From molecule_dictionary
Left Join compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Left Join docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Left Join activities on compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id
Left Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Left Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Left Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123873'
And compound_structures.canonical_smiles is not null
Order by molecule_chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles"
}
